status: NEW (G4 confirmatory: the declared spike endpoint re-tested with new seeds, newly drawn locations, independent null data, noise replicates and a detector-mismatch variant)
context: sample scaled by 0.895 (size-only control); Neuromag helmet at the 'top' placement (magnetometer-to-scalp median 34.1 mm), OPM dense 174 and matched 89 sites (G3B rules); adult background scale per unit area

definition.test: two-sided exact sign-flip test on the per-location differences in detection counts (detection.sign_flip_p)
definition.effect: paired S50 ratio Neuromag / OPM from the location-pooled detection curves, location bootstrap (censored interval)

endpoint.test: two-sided exact sign-flip test on the per-location differences in detection counts (detection.sign_flip_p)
endpoint.effect: paired S50 ratio Neuromag / OPM from the location-pooled detection curves, location bootstrap (censored interval)

comparisons: opm_matched/opm vs squid/combined (practical detector, frozen thresholds)
oracle detector (known topography, waveform and time; per-trial false-positive probability oracle_alpha)
practical detector at thresholds matched to 1 false event per minute on the held-out null, rates evaluated on the independent evaluation null
detector-mismatch variant (below), frozen and matched thresholds
Monte Carlo variability: the endpoint in every noise replicate, and pooled over the replicates

events.waveform: Hunold et al. 2016 Fig. 2b spike-wave complex (digitised), through the analysis filter

detector.dictionary: Poisson-disk grid (dictionary_spacing_mm) on usable vertices, cortical normal; the true sources are other vertices

declared_choices.sign_flip_test: Monte Carlo, 20,000 sign patterns (detection.sign_flip_p, more than 20 locations)

primary.dictionary: truth forward model (3-layer BEM, exact coregistration)

declared_choices.note: a variant is a complete detector: its thresholds are calibrated on the same null data to the same false-event rate, so every detector is compared at the same operating point; a bank with fewer templates searches less and gets a lower threshold, a shift common to the arrays

seeds.rule: np.random.SeedSequence(root_seed, spawn_key=(anatomy_index, purpose_index[, replicate or statistic]))
